text:
sam: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a prod TF change to move from a single cross-az NAT to zonal NAT Gateways (one per AZ) and to wire a PrivateLink endpoint for metrics ingestion. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/482 — looking for quick reviews on route table association ordering, EIP allocation, and any PrivateLink gotchas.

maria: Quick q — are we doing aws_nat_gateway (managed) or NAT instances? The PR mentions aws_eip resources per AZ, but just double-checking allocation_count/logic so we don't accidentally leak addresses.

sam: We're using aws_nat_gateway. Plan is to allocate 1 EIP per AZ and attach it to the nat_gateway in that AZ. Snippet from the branch:

```hcl
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  count = length(var.azs)
  vpc   = true
  tags  = { Name = "nat-eip-${count.index}" }
}
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "this" {
  count         = length(var.azs)
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[count.index].id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.egress[count.index].id
}
```

jordan: One operational note: ordering matters — ensure route table associations and new routes are created before flipping the default route from the old nat to the new zonal natgws. In TF we usually do create_before_destroy on the route resources or add explicit depends_on so the new RTs and routes exist prior to removing the old default route. Otherwise you can get transient blackhole traffic.

rory: For PrivateLink: cross-account service attachment — do we have the consumer side IAM role / principals and the endpoint service permissions sorted? Also DNS: we'll need Route53 Resolver rules or split-horizon entries so service FQNs resolve to the endpoint IPs in the consumer VPCs.

sam: Yes — PR includes aws_vpc_endpoint_service and aws_vpc_endpoint. Also adding aws_route53_resolver_rule + vpc association. Start with a limited canary: enable PrivateLink + zonal NAT only in az-1 and az-2 for the canary cluster, then roll out.

terraform-bot: plan: https://ci.internal/terraform/plan/infra/482 — Plan: +8 to add, ~2 to change, -4 to destroy. No tainted resources.

maria: Please add a short runbook with rollback steps (how to re-point routes to the old NAT, deallocate EIPs safely, and verify metrics after PrivateLink flip). Also ensure we tag the EIPs and NATs with billing tags. After runbook + small CI smoke test I'm +1.

sam: Will add runbook and smoke jobs, plan migration window for low traffic. Thanks all :thumbsup:
